scientific_integrity: Analytic infinite-dimensional trace and Gamma-ratio proof; independent verification and priority confirmation not asserted. Finite numerical diagnostics are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed distinct degrees, strictly positive radial damping speeds and fixed Bergman exponent. The public abstract, but not the complete text, of the most directly motivating 2026 publisher article was available; priority comparison is consequently qualified.
title: Arithmetic collision residue for Schatten-four norms of radially damped Bergman composition differences
